title.en: Paper Boats: the poem in brief

text.en:
On a rainy day Meena made a paper boat and wrote her name on it.
"Where will it go?" she wondered.

This poem is by Rabindranath Tagore. A child makes paper boats every day and floats them on the flowing water, writing his name and village on each one.
He hopes that someone in a faraway place will read the name and know where the boat has come from. He imagines the boat meeting the night and the dreams of strangers.
The poem shows a child's imagination and wish to reach out to the wider world. This summary is based on the well-known story or poem and on public chapter notes. Please read the exact text in the textbook, because the textbook version may differ in details.

text.en: The boat goes far away on the water.
